items.content: Use one agent to do the work and another to review it against a rubric. @trq212 explains how this works for video shorts: “For something like, ‘Is this a good video short or not?’ you don’t have a deterministic answer. You should have a separate verification agent read a rubric, review the short, and give feedback. We call it self-preferential bias. When a model prefers its own output, it’s going to be more lenient at verifying it.” 📌 Watch the full episode here: https://t.co/mMrt4D5qU7
